entities.name: LangGraph
entities.desc: Stateful, graph-based orchestration for multi-actor agents
entities.detail: A low-level orchestration framework from the LangChain team for building stateful, multi-actor agents as graphs. Supports durable execution, human-in-the-loop, streaming, and persistent memory across steps.

entities.name: CrewAI
entities.desc: Role-playing autonomous agents that collaborate on tasks
entities.detail: A standalone framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous agents. Define agents with roles, goals, and tools, then compose them into crews that collaborate on complex tasks.

entities.name: AutoGen
entities.desc: Multi-agent conversation framework for LLM apps
entities.detail: Microsoft's framework for building multi-agent LLM applications through conversation. Agents message one another — and optionally humans — to solve tasks, with support for code execution and tool use.

entities.name: Swarm
entities.detail: OpenAI's lightweight, educational framework exploring ergonomic multi-agent orchestration through simple primitives — agents and handoffs — rather than a heavy runtime.

entities.name: AutoGPT
entities.detail: One of the first autonomous GPT agent platforms. It chains LLM calls to pursue a goal with minimal human input, and has grown into a broader platform for building and deploying agents.

entities.name: Unsloth
entities.detail: Makes LLM fine-tuning up to 2× faster and far more memory-efficient through custom kernels. Supports LoRA/QLoRA on consumer GPUs for popular open models.

entities.name: PEFT
entities.detail: Hugging Face's library for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Implements LoRA, prefix tuning, prompt tuning, and more so you adapt large models by training only a small set of parameters.

entities.name: Axolotl
entities.detail: A config-driven tool that wraps the open-model fine-tuning stack. Define dataset, model, and method in YAML and it handles LoRA/QLoRA, multi-GPU, and sequence packing.

entities.name: LoRA
entities.detail: Low-Rank Adaptation — the foundational method that freezes the base model and trains small low-rank matrices, drastically cutting the cost of fine-tuning large models. Microsoft's reference implementation.

entities.name: LLaMA-Factory
entities.detail: A unified toolkit for fine-tuning 100+ LLMs and VLMs through a single interface. Supports full/LoRA/QLoRA tuning, many training methods, and a web UI.

entities.name: LlamaIndex
entities.detail: A data framework for connecting custom and private data to LLMs. Provides loaders, indexes, retrievers, and query engines for building RAG and agentic apps over your own sources.

entities.name: LangChain
entities.detail: The widely-used framework for composing LLM applications from modular building blocks — models, prompts, retrievers, tools, and chains — with a large ecosystem of integrations.

entities.name: Haystack
entities.detail: deepset's end-to-end framework for building production search and RAG pipelines. Composable components connect retrievers, readers, and generators into deployable pipelines.

entities.name: RAGAS
entities.detail: An evaluation toolkit for RAG pipelines. Provides reference-free metrics — faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision and recall — to measure and improve retrieval-augmented systems.

entities.name: RAGFlow
entities.detail: An open-source RAG engine built around deep document understanding. It parses complex documents — tables, layouts — for high-quality, citation-grounded retrieval.

entities.name: DSPy
entities.detail: Stanford's framework for programming — rather than prompting — language models. You write declarative modules and DSPy compiles and optimizes the prompts (and weights) automatically.

entities.name: Guidance
entities.detail: A library for constrained generation that interleaves control flow with LLM output. Enforce structure, regex, and grammars so models produce exactly the format you need.

entities.name: Priompt
entities.detail: Anysphere's (Cursor) priority-based prompt design library. Treats prompt construction like rendering, keeping the most important content when the context budget is tight.

entities.name: vLLM
entities.detail: A high-throughput, memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs. Its PagedAttention and continuous batching deliver state-of-the-art throughput for production serving.

entities.name: Ollama
entities.detail: The simplest way to run open LLMs locally. A single command pulls and runs quantized models and exposes an API — popular for local development and private inference.

entities.name: TGI
entities.detail: Hugging Face's Text Generation Inference — a production-grade toolkit for serving LLMs with tensor parallelism, continuous batching, and optimized kernels.

entities.name: SGLang
entities.desc: Fast serving for complex LLM programs
entities.detail: A fast serving framework for complex LLM programs. Its RadixAttention and structured-generation runtime speed up multi-call, agentic, and structured workloads.

entities.name: TensorRT-LLM
entities.detail: NVIDIA's library for optimizing and serving LLM inference on its GPUs. Compiles models into highly optimized TensorRT engines for maximum throughput and low latency.

entities.name: Qdrant
entities.detail: A high-performance, open-source vector database written in Rust. Offers fast filtered similarity search, rich payloads, and horizontal scaling for production vector workloads.

entities.name: Weaviate
entities.detail: An open-source vector database with built-in vectorization modules and hybrid search. Combines semantic and keyword retrieval behind a simple API.

entities.name: ChromaDB
entities.detail: A developer-friendly, open-source embeddings database. Popular for prototyping RAG apps — store, embed, and query documents with a minimal Python API.

entities.name: pgvector
entities.detail: A PostgreSQL extension that adds vector similarity search to your existing database. Store embeddings alongside relational data and query them with familiar SQL.

entities.name: MLflow
entities.detail: An open-source platform for the ML lifecycle — experiment tracking, model registry, packaging, and deployment — with growing first-class support for LLMs and prompts.

entities.name: W&B
entities.detail: Weights & Biases — experiment tracking, evaluation, and observability for ML and LLM development. Logs runs, visualizes metrics, and includes tools for prompt and model evaluation.

entities.name: ZenML
entities.detail: An extensible, open-source MLOps framework for building portable, production-ready pipelines. Abstracts infrastructure so the same pipeline runs locally or in the cloud.

entities.name: Langfuse
entities.detail: An open-source LLM engineering platform for tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and metrics. Instrument your app to debug and monitor LLM calls end to end.

entities.name: LangSmith
entities.detail: LangChain's platform for debugging, testing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM applications. Captures detailed traces and supports datasets and evals — with or without LangChain.

entities.name: Phoenix
entities.detail: Arize's open-source tool for LLM tracing and evaluation. Built on OpenTelemetry, it visualizes traces and runs evals to find and fix issues in LLM apps.

entities.name: Helicone
entities.detail: An open-source LLM observability platform that works as a proxy or via SDKs. Logs requests, tracks cost and latency, and adds caching and rate limiting with a one-line change.

entities.name: TruLens
entities.detail: An open-source library for evaluating and tracking LLM app quality. Its feedback functions score relevance, groundedness, and more to systematically improve apps.
